note: Starter rules for people with little Claude Code history. Only nagging, em dashes and unrequested document files are checked after the fact, because those are the checks Kev-0.8B passed in testing. The rest are prevention-only.

rules.question: Is this file a document, template, log or plan the user did not ask for?
rules.avoid: Only create files the user asked for. Give plans, prompts and explanations in chat unless asked to save them.

rules.question: Does this change add infrastructure, abstractions, options or features beyond what the request needs?
rules.avoid: Make only the change that was asked for. No extra features, config or abstractions.

rules.question: Is this reply clearly longer than the request needs, because of repetition, restated summaries or filler?
rules.avoid: Answer in as few words as the request allows. No restated summaries or filler.

rules.question: Does this closing text offer more help, ask the user for more details, or suggest a follow-up the user did not ask for?

criteria.true: An offer, question or invitation to continue
criteria.false: A plain statement, note, caveat or the end of the content

rules.avoid: Don't end with offers, next steps or questions the user didn't ask for.

rules.question: Does the reply state facts or numbers as certain without showing that they were checked?
rules.avoid: Only state facts you have checked, and mark estimates clearly.
rules.when: Does a good answer depend on real-world facts, numbers, statistics or market data?

rules.question: Is the content generic enough that it could have been written for almost any project or person?
rules.avoid: Be specific to this user's situation. Avoid obvious, generic ideas.
rules.when: Is the user asking for ideas, names, suggestions or other creative options?
